newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nycomed jumps on restructuring, cost cut.
newsitem.headline: Nycomed jumps on restructuring, cost cut.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian pharmaceuticals group Nycomed ASA advanced strongly on Thursday after the company announced a series of measures to cut costs and restructure operations.
Nycomed's A share surged six crowns, or more than seven percent, to 89 crowns in early trade while the Bs gained 5.50 crowns to 87 crowns.

Nycomed said it expected to make savings of 600 million crowns from a new programme, Focus '98. The programme involves adjusting the group's strategy to reduce costs in some areas and increase investment in other areas.
The savings are expected to be fully effective by 1998.

"This is what the market has been waiting for," said one Oslo-based broker. "Restructuring, cost cutting and a refocus. The market is bullish on this. In the short-run we see potential of (a share price for the A stock) of 100 crowns."
